responses.ensemble_reason: I kept a single model, Logistic Regression. It had the best mean Average Precision across the three forward folds (0.392, fold SD 0.030), ahead of XGBoost (0.353) and LightGBM (0.346). No ensemble beat it: equal averaging scored 0.372 (-0.020), weighted averaging 0.389 (-0.002) and stacking 0.383 (-0.009), so none came close to the required gain of more than 0.030. Brier (0.0633 vs 0.0633) and ECE (0.0188 vs 0.0177) were also no better in a way that would justify the extra complexity. Gate result: KEEP SINGLE.
responses.validation_limits: The evidence is nested forward OOF: folds 2023Q1, 2023Q3 and 2024Q1, training far enough in the past for 90-day outcomes to mature, validation customers removed from training, and ensemble weights and the stacker learned on inner OOF only. The limits are that three periods overlap in their training history, so the fold SD (0.030) is descriptive and not a confidence interval, that the AP gaps between candidates are small, and that the same training data was used earlier in the course, so this is not an untouched final test.
responses.calibration_limits: The sigmoid was learned on a reserved period (July to September 2024, 836 rows, 78 positives) kept out of the fit pool, but its diagnostics are scored on those same rows, so they are fit diagnostics, not independent evidence. On them the sigmoid left ranking unchanged (AP 0.288, ROC-AUC 0.789) and did not improve calibration (Brier 0.0765 to 0.0781, ECE 0.0211 to 0.0349), which suggests the unweighted logistic scores were already reasonably calibrated. With only 78 positives the estimate is noisy, and no challenge labels exist to test it.
responses.capacity_fairness: Capacity was applied once to the whole 2,500-request batch: 330 requests were above the transported threshold (0.1223), the 300-request cap kept 300 and removed 30 (boundary score 0.1299), and no equal-score block was split. The regional OOF flag rate among negatives ranges from 6.3% (eastern) to 10.3% (western), a gap of 3.98 percentage points, with 486 to 507 negatives per region. This is a descriptive diagnostic with no confidence interval and is not a fairness certificate; challenge FPR cannot be computed without labels.
responses.explanation_scope: The Day 4 explanations belong to the class-weighted LightGBM of Day 4. The final model is an unweighted Logistic Regression with a sigmoid calibrator, so those SHAP values and reason codes do not transfer to it. For the final model I would need to recheck its own coefficients or SHAP values, the calibration, and the review zone against the 12% capacity before explaining any individual decision.
responses.intended_use: This is a fictional training exercise on synthetic data. The flags simulate sending a request to review. It must not be used for real financing, to approve or reject an applicant, or as evidence about real people or regions.
responses.monitoring_plan: Track feature and score distributions against the training data for drift; the share of requests flagged per period against the 12% capacity; calibration (Brier, ECE and reliability) on each newly labelled period, recalibrating or retraining when it drifts; and the regional flag rate and recall. Because the transported threshold can change flag volume after refitting, capacity must be checked on every new batch before use.
responses.executive_summary_ar: اخترنا نموذج Logistic Regression منفرداً لأنه حقق أعلى متوسط Average Precision (0.392) عبر الطيات الأمامية الثلاث، ولم يتجاوزه أي تجميع بالقدر المطلوب (أكثر من 0.030). عُيّرت الاحتمالات بتحويل sigmoid، وطُبقت سعة 12% مرة واحدة على دفعة التحدي (300 إشارة من 2,500 طلب). البيانات اصطناعية والنتائج للتدريب فقط.
responses.executive_summary_en: We chose a single Logistic Regression because it had the best mean Average Precision (0.392) across three forward folds, and no ensemble beat it by more than the 0.030 fold SD. Probabilities were calibrated with a sigmoid and the 12% capacity was applied once to the challenge batch (300 flags of 2,500 requests). The data are synthetic and the results are for training only.
